retractions.claim: <regex for the withdrawn wording, loose enough to catch paraphrases>
retractions.current: <optional regex for the corrected wording; a line containing it counts as updated>
retractions.note: <one line: what was wrong, and which TROUBLES type it belongs to>

allow: <path:line of a line that quotes the claim but must not be edited, e.g. a pre-registered decision rule>
